name: OpenTelemetry to PROV-O mapping
abstract: Experimental RML mapping from an OTLP trace to PROV-O activities, agents, entities, usages, and associations.
description: The transform converts OTLP resourceSpans into an IPT-qualified result. Span and trace records become PROV activities; dpl.objects.data_object_def values become PROV entities; and dpl.core.processing_activity_id and dpl.core.data_subject_id values become PROV agents.

transforms.description: Convert an OpenTelemetry OTLP JSON trace into an IPT-qualified PROV activity result.

examples.title: OTLP to PROV-O transform input
examples.content: An OTLP trace transformed into a PROV-O JSON-LD graph.
